title: GpuMemoryReservation
description: A logical resource reservation in the rebalancer's ledger (specs/46 §5 and specs/50). Legacy GPU-memory reservations remain valid. contractVersion 1 adds the idempotency, fencing, progress-liveness and safe-peak resource envelope required for runtime loading; expiry is based on absence of observable progress, never elapsed wall duration alone.

contractVersion.description: Presence selects the additive runtime-reservation contract. Absence is the legacy specs/46 reservation shape.

reservationId.description: Printable ASCII without spaces, so 128 characters is 128 UTF-8 bytes on every reader.

decisionId.description: Printable ASCII without spaces, so 128 characters is 128 UTF-8 bytes on every reader.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable across retries of the same logical reservation; the authority returns the same reservation and never double-books it.

fencingEpoch.description: Monotonic authority epoch. Commands carrying an older epoch cannot load, mutate or release the reservation.

gatewayId.description: A node or gateway id: printable ASCII without spaces and without '/', the separator of GPU resource ids.

resourceId.description: Printable ASCII without spaces, so 128 characters is 128 UTF-8 bytes on every reader.

physicalResourceKey.description: Stable physical node/device de-duplication key. It excludes the advertising parent so the same GPU learned through multiple parents remains one resource.

parentId.description: Advertising path provenance only; never part of physicalResourceKey.

placementGroupId.description: Shared by every GPU of a multi-GPU placement.

modelId.description: Printable ASCII without spaces, so 128 characters is 128 UTF-8 bytes on every reader.

placementClass.description: Absent means normal. A reader that meets a value it does not know treats it as primary (never evicted, never packed against).

effectiveBytes.description: Shrinks as the runtime's allocation appears, so a reservation that became physical is never subtracted twice.

gpuSafePeakBytes.description: Independently estimated contributors to the safe peak. Admission sums these contributors with headroom; weights alone are never the admission envelope.

lastProgressAt.description: Timestamp of the latest observable monotonic progress event. A lease may expire only when this fails to advance for the negotiated progress timeout.

progressSequence.description: Monotonic progress sequence used to distinguish a live long load from an abandoned reservation.

createdAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp (producer clock; display only).

expiresAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp (producer clock; display only).
